task_origin: deterministic defects in pinned real open-source repositories; not historical issue benchmark scores
split_policy: Train uses only original 012 train partition. Original dev/test are historical regression; only two new repositories are fresh holdout. Fixed constructed mutations, not historical issue or SWE-bench scores.

accepted_action_formats: one Qwen XML bash/command tool call

training_candidate.method: BF16 frozen backbone, rank-8 LoRA, assistant-output-only SFT
training_candidate.example_selection: Validate 012 source rights/admission; deduplicate exact message+target pairs; reject target >512 or total >4096 tokens; allocate 96 slots round-robin over every admitted training task; select uniformly spaced trajectory positions within each quota; seeded shuffle101, one pass.
supervision: local base-model trajectories passing task checks
explicitly labeled reference-repair demonstrations from authorized training snapshots

comparison.primary: paired task success: targeted checks and declared regression suite pass, no protected file tampering
comparison.resumption: persist completed tool boundaries, reconstruct a new controller from saved state and workspace, preserve consumed budgets; separately disclose lack of mid-command crash recovery

regression_scope_exclusions.more-itertools: TestConcurrentTee thread-stress class exceeds process guard and is unrelated to selected iterator APIs

regression_scope_exclusions.underscore: authored modules rebuilt with upstream non-strict UMD settings before six upstream test files run

promotion.meaning: advance to multi-seed replication, not daily-use certification or weight release

comparison_note: This compares the fixed candidate with the unchanged base under the same runtime. It is not a causal ablation against 012: sample selection, target length filtering, and the validated 013 training runtime differ.
sample_size_warning: 12 constructed tasks clustered in two small repositories, one training seed; no general coding or long-task quality claim.
